name: publicWeb_getSongs
description: Returns all non-removed songs mapped (non-removed HC.KennelSongMap row) to a kennel, ordered by Rank ASC then SongName ASC, for the public songs page. Unauthenticated. An unknown, deleted or removed kennel returns an empty typed rowset (same columns, 0 rows); a NULL @publicKennelId or a runtime error returns the { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } envelope.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Public GUID of the kennel whose songs to return

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Validation text or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH

rowsets.description: Instead of Songs when @publicKennelId is NULL ('publicKennelId is required.') or on any runtime error (CATCH, ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: Songs
rowsets.description: Zero or more song rows ordered by Rank ASC, SongName ASC. Empty when the kennel is not found/inactive (lines 45-58, typed WHERE 1 = 0 select) or has no assigned songs.

columns.name: TuneOf
columns.description: Tune this song is sung to

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 84-86 return { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } without inserting an HC.ErrorLog row, so a runtime failure is invisible server-side. PublicWebApi does log a Success = 0 envelope as 'HC6 Public Web Error: <action>' with the message, so the failure is not lost, but the row carries no SP name or parameters.

codeSmells.issue: Kennel-not-found returns empty rowset instead of error envelope
codeSmells.detail: Lines 42-60 return an empty typed rowset where publicWeb_getSong returns 'Kennel not found.' for the same condition. The comment says 'shim will treat as 404'; callers simply see an empty list. Harmless but inconsistent.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from the rowset
Never change the sort order without confirming with callers
The column set must exactly match publicWeb_getSong rowset 0 — they're consumed by the same TypeScript type
